correctness.rationale: Uniform P1 consistent-mass and stiffness matrices M=hT/6,S=K/h give H=h²M^-1S=6T^-1K. N=1 gives e^(-3τ)>0; N=2 generator −H Metzler irreducible, giving strictly positive matrix exponential. At N=3 independently verified H has diagonal (51/14,30/7,51/14), adjacent −18/7 and corner +9/14, with eigenvalues (30±18sqrt2)/7 and 3. Sine spectral projectors yield E13=(e^(−λ1τ)+e^(−λ3τ))/4−e^(−3τ)/2; nearest couplings (sqrt2/4)(e^(−λ1τ)−e^(−λ3τ))>0, diagonals positive. Sign of E13 equals sign of g(τ)=exp((3−λ1)τ)+exp(−(λ3−3)τ)−2: g(0)=0,g'(0)<0,g''>0, g→∞; unique positive crossing τ*=0.212811776921..., so failure precisely (0,τ*h²) and strictly positive after. Independently checked exact rational matrices/SymPy eigenvalues, scipy exponentials and high-precision root. No extrapolation to N≥4.
